notes.title: Dwerve is 15% off! New Quality of Life Update Now Live!
notes.notes:
Hi Warsmiths!

15% Discount!

Dwerve is 15% off until November 14 as part of two back-to-back Steam events: IndieCade and Indie X!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1132760/Dwerve/

To kickoff these events, we've released a new Quality of Life Update! 5 months after launch, we've continued to work hard to improve the game with the help of our community! Thanks to everyone who gave us feedback! ❤️

5 Month Progress

Here's some of the key changes we've made over the past few months:

- Balanced a ton of turrets, upgrades, and enemies
- Streamlined levels design for more fluid progression
- Improved battles to offer a more strategic experience
- Removed redundant or tedious puzzles
- Removed unnecessary dialogues for less interruption
- Increased Dwerve's movement speed — several times!
- Added a ton of more graphics and UX options
- Added ability to move through your own turrets
- Added selling upgrades back at full price
- Added more health potions and armor drops
- Added backtracking to collect missed keys
- Added build preview to see where your turret will get built
- Added recall preview to see which turret will get recalled
- Added ability to skip dialogues and fast-forward cutscenes
- Added exclamation particles to indicate battle triggers
- Optimized the build size
- Made all sneak sections optional
- Fixed a gazillion bugs

We're happy with how much the game has improved thanks to you all! Now we can focus on new features like.... * drum roll * ...

Classic TD Mode!

Classic TD is a new upcoming game mode that has traditional tower defense gameplay. Build more and more turrets over time to defeat waves of enemies before they reach the objective. The game mode is currently in Beta testing but will be released as part of the main game in the coming weeks!

notes.title: v1.1.0 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
- Added exclamation particles to indicate battle triggers
- Added gamepad vibration for supported controllers
- Added difficulty prompt when start new game
- Fixed slimes spawning smaller slimes in unreachable areas
- Fixed drop loot spawning loot in unreachable areas
- Fixed new turrets not getting equipped to the same slot
- Fixed troll assassin attack radius being too large
- Fixed unpausing game with gamepad buttons also building a turret
- Removed more miscellaneous dialogues to streamline levels

notes.title: v1.0.10 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
Added more health potions and armor drops
 Added dialogue voice volume slider to audio options
 Added 30% chance for default/neutral voice sounds to play
 Added build preview so you can see where the turret will be built
 Added recall preview so you can see which turret will get recalled
 Added greyed out icons for locked upgrades to the workbench menu
 Added leave level confirmation prompt so you can make sure you are ready to leave
 Added skip ui for dialogues/camera pans so you know to hold select button to skip
 Removed player collision with turrets so you can move through them
 Removed a ton of fluff dialogues so the gameplay is interrupted less
 Balanced crossbow turret upgrades
 Increased top-tier upgrade price from 60 to 80
 Improved gamepad support for main menu and workbench
 Fixed bug where default resolution was not set correctly
 Fixed mouse cursor not always showing when using mouse
 Fixed getting stuck on grey screen if die after Kakaaw dies
 Fixed checkpoints not saving progress if any enemy spawner was active
 Fixed not being able to backtrack to certain keys or chests
